pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, jagged polygons with star-like projections. Edges show sharp pixel gradients. Relative area of patches is smaller on the cervical region and increases significantly on the lateral flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pathways. Junction nodes connect multiple paths with increased pixel thickness at intersections compared to mid-path segments.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the cervical margin against the background. The mane displays a consistent serrated edge.
